top_signals.title: South Sudan Readies Licensing Round to Boost Oil Production
top_signals.summary: South Sudan plans to launch a licensing round for five blocks as it looks to boost its oil production in the coming years, caretaker Petroleum Minister Awow Daniel Chuang said at an industry event in the country.  The upcoming licensing round is part of South Sudan’s push to commercialize the country’s 14 available greenfield blocks and increase crude oil production from just under 170,000 barrels per day (bpd) at present to 200,000 bpd within the next two to three years, the official said at the South Sudan Oil & Power 2026…

top_signals.title: El Niño, Flooding Put Squeeze on South African Fruit Producers
top_signals.summary: South Africa’s high-value fruit exports are under pressure due to adverse weather ranging from winter floods to heat waves linked to the El Niño weather phenomenon, with growers cutting harvest forecasts for grapes and stone fruit.
